units.source_text: 我和住在横滨的美国人约定，在十一月的时候会把雏人偶卖给他。

en.t: I had arranged with an American living in Yokohama to sell him the hina dolls in November.

units.source_text: 我家店铺的名字叫做纪之国屋，父辈们几代都开钱庄的，钱庄主要是为各路诸侯筹措资金。

en.t: Our family shop was called Kinokuniya, and for generations my forebears had run a money-changing business, mainly raising funds for various feudal lords.

units.source_text: 尤其是我的祖父，祖父号为紫竹，是一个十分有情趣的风雅之士，他给我留下来的那套雏人偶也是十分精巧细致。

en.t: My grandfather in particular, who used the art name Shichiku, was a man of very refined and elegant tastes, and the set of hina dolls he left me was also exquisitely delicate and finely made.

units.source_text: 以此为例，摆放在最高层皇居内，皇后人偶头上的皇冠是以珊瑚镶嵌的璎珞做装饰，

en.t: For example, in the palace arranged on the top tier, the crown on the empress doll's head was decorated with coral-inlaid pendants,

units.source_text: 天皇人偶佩戴腰带是丝绸质地，上面交替绣着表纹和里纹，

en.t: and the sash worn by the emperor doll was made of silk, with outer and inner patterns embroidered on it alternately,

units.source_text: 这套雏人偶就是这么的精致考究。

en.t: that was how refined and carefully crafted this set of hina dolls was.
